pages.text:
## Fight to Defend Our Values
Fight for our conservative movement. Donate now!
## Experience.
When experience matters most.
## Will You Join the Fight?
By providing your phone number and opting in, you are consenting to receive texts, including automated texts, to that number. You may also opt in by texting Mitch to 47137. You will receive a confirmation text from 47137. Message frequency may vary. Msg&Data Rates May Apply. Reply STOP to cancel. Reply HELP for help. Privacy Policy Terms of Service
Mitch McConnell has led the fight for our conservative values in the Senate. Confirming three Supreme Court Justices, cutting government regulations, and passing historic middle-class tax cuts.
Left-wing billionaires, progressive activists, and Hollywood liberals will fund our opponents. They will raise millions to flood the airwaves with attack ads and baseless smears.
We’re counting on you to fight back. Please click below and donate whatever you can right now.
How can you help? Click the boxes below to let us know.
